facts.business: Bharti Hexacom Limited, a subsidiary of Bharti Airtel Limited, provides mobile, fixed-line, broadband, IPTV, and digital services to over 29 million customers across Rajasthan and the North-East.

segments.name: Homes & Office Broadband (Wi-Fi, FWA, FTTH, IPTV)
Converged Offerings (Bundled mobile, Wi-Fi, Digital TV)

key_risks: No physical verification of customer premises equipment, bandwidth, and optic fiber cable due to nature/location
Dependence on Bharti Airtel Group for ESG governance and policies
facts.related_party_note: Indemnification asset recognised towards provisions as per business purchase agreement with TTSL; interest on AGR provision pursuant to merger with TTSL.
